To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we design polynomial time schemes, described through LP formulations, for secrecy over erasue networks with feedback; (2) our schemes outperform the best-known alternatives in the literature; and (3) our LPs extend to incorporate several scenaria of interest, including the cases of secrecy under jamming and secrecy under eavesdropping.

(i) LP formulations are a useful tool to design secure schemes in erasure networks with public feedback, and (ii) LP formulations for secure schemes in erasures networks with public feedback are not always capacity achieving, and the reason is not due to a sub-optimal choice of paths, but rather due to the sub-optimality of the LPs themselves.
(i) the capacity region of secrecy over erasure broadcast networks is not known, and (ii) the secrecy capacity region of the Gaussian erasure broadcast channel with feedback is not known.
In summary, our research is concerned with
(i) LP formulations for secrecy over networks with erasures, (ii) secrecy over erasure channels with feedback, and (iii) secrecy over erasures and erasures with feedback.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we design LPs to solve the secrecy problem for erasure networks with arbitrary topologies and feedback.
, for the first time, the secrecy capacity region of a general network with erasures and feedback is characterized by a finite number of LPs.
we propose a general LP-based approach to secrecy over erasure channels, which can handle a wide range of practical scenarios, including the case of multiple eavesdroppers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the context of secrecy over erasure channels with feedback, LP formulations are a powerful design tool.
, by using LPs, we can design secrecy-achieving schemes that are both practical and optimal in certain regimes.
LPs are a very powerful and general tool for the design and analysis of secrecy in erasure networks with public feedback.
